from pathlib import Path
import json, os, random, statistics, subprocess, sys
root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'benchmarks'))
import own_build, phase_ci, interleaved, survey
out = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
base = 'b8adaa6598177a13aca6e35efccee63e30f9c883'
head = '29de9fd7799a92bf33c060a534e1c0269a787d40'
selected = own_build.toolchains()
builds, runtimes = {}, {}
for ref, revision in [('base',base),('head',head)]:
    for compiler, tc in selected.items():
        name = ref + '-' + compiler
        target = root / 'artifacts/interpreter-dispatch-20261102' / ('head-' + compiler) if ref == 'base' else out / name
        identity = target / 'identity.json'
        if not identity.exists():
            own_build.archive(root, revision, target)
            hashes = own_build.hashes(target, own_build.ENGINE_PATHS, own_build.HARNESS)
            path = target / 'internal/bench/phase/phase.go'
            source = path.read_text()
            source = source.replace('config.Backend = args.backend','config.Backend = args.backend\n config.Features = wasm.SupportedFeatures',1)
            source = source.replace('unmetered; bounded cancellation; checked Core 2.0','unmetered; bounded cancellation; checked Core 3.0 + Threads')
            path.write_text(source)
            (target / 'internal/bench/phase/provenance_gen.go').write_text('package phase\nfunc init(){sourceRevision='+json.dumps(revision)+';compilerRevision='+json.dumps(tc['revision'])+'}\n')
            binary = target / 'wasmvm-phase'
            command = [tc['command'],'build',*tc['buildFlags'],'-o',str(binary),'./benchmarks/embedded/wasmvm']
            subprocess.run(command,cwd=target,env=dict(os.environ,CGO_ENABLED='1',GOWORK='off',GOFLAGS='',GOTOOLCHAIN='local'),check=True,timeout=600)
            if own_build.hashes(target,own_build.ENGINE_PATHS,own_build.HARNESS)!=hashes:
                raise ValueError('engine sources changed')
            identity.write_text(json.dumps(dict(sourceRevision=revision,sourceHashes=hashes,sourceDigest=own_build.source_digest(hashes),toolchain=tc,instrumentation=source,command=command,binary=str(binary),binarySha256=survey.digest(binary)),indent=2)+'\n')
        builds[name] = json.loads(identity.read_text())
        if builds[name]['sourceRevision']!=revision or survey.digest(Path(builds[name]['binary']))!=builds[name]['binarySha256']:
            raise ValueError('stale binary')
        for backend in ('interpreter','native'):
            runtimes[name+'-'+backend] = dict(command=[builds[name]['binary'],'--mode','api'],backend=backend,compiler='gc' if compiler=='go' else 'llgo',compilerRevision=tc['revision'],sourceRevision=revision,engine='wasmvm',mode='api',goos='darwin',goarch='arm64',policy='unmetered; bounded cancellation; checked Core 3.0 + Threads')
        print('built',name,flush=True)
previous = json.loads((root/'artifacts/survey-20261101/modern/build.json').read_text())
for name in ('wasmtime-cranelift','wasmedge-interpreter','wazero-compiler','wazero-interpreter','wasmer-cranelift'):
    r = previous['runtimes'][name]
    runtimes[name] = r
    key = name.split('-')[0]
    builds[name] = previous['builds'][key]
    if survey.digest(Path(builds[name]['binary']))!=builds[name]['binarySha256']:
        raise ValueError('reference binary changed')
(out/'build.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(base=base,head=head,builds=builds,runtimes=runtimes),indent=2)+'\n')
if '--build-only' in sys.argv:
    sys.exit(0)
manifest = json.loads((root/'benchmarks/modern/manifest.json').read_text())
fixtures=[]
for f in manifest['workloads'][4:7]:
    for suffix in ('wasm','wat'):
        if survey.digest(root/'benchmarks/modern'/f[suffix])!=f[suffix+'Sha256']:
            raise ValueError('fixture changed')
    fixtures.append(dict(f,path=str(root/'benchmarks/modern'/f['wasm']),unit='ns/source iteration'))
import importlib.util

def oracle(name):
    path=root/'benchmarks/native'/(name+'_fixtures.py')
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name+'_oracle',path)
    module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module.checksum
memory_oracle,runtime_oracle=oracle('memory'),oracle('runtime')
selected_cases={'core/integer-loop','core/function-calls','core/memory-load-store',
 'memory/narrow-unaligned','memory/dependent-address','memory/float64-unaligned',
 'runtime/simd-memory-full','runtime/simd-memory-widen','runtime/simd-memory-lanes'}
for f in survey.fixtures(root):
    if f['id'] not in selected_cases:continue
    f=dict(f)
    if f['family'] in ('memory','runtime'):
        checksum=memory_oracle if f['family']=='memory' else runtime_oracle
        assert checksum(f['id'].split('/')[1],f['seed'],f['iterations'])==f['expectedChecksum']
        f['alternateExpectedChecksum']=checksum(f['id'].split('/')[1],4294967295,17)
    else:
        f['alternateExpectedChecksum']=next(x['expectedChecksum'] for x in f['validationCases'] if x['seed']==4294967295 and x['iterations']==17)
    fixtures.append(f)
assert len(fixtures)==12
report = dict(status='running',acceptance='not evaluated; descriptive shared-host targeted comparison',base=base,head=head,sourceRevision=head,hostLoadBefore=os.getloadavg(),runtimes=runtimes,cases=[],checks=[],unsupported=[])
rng=random.Random(20261102)
for f in fixtures:
    commands={name:r['command']+['--backend',r['backend'],'--wasm',f['path'],'--iterations',str(f['iterations']),'--seed',str(f['seed']),'--expected',str(f['expectedChecksum']),'--samples','7','--warmups','2'] for name,r in runtimes.items()}
    if f.get('requiresGC',False):
        for name in ('wazero-compiler','wazero-interpreter','wasmer-cranelift'):
            try:
                phase_ci.invoke(commands.pop(name),180)
            except RuntimeError as e:
                import survey_modern
                if not survey_modern.expected_gc_rejection(name,e):
                    raise
                report['unsupported'].append(dict(runtime=name,workload=f['id'],error=str(e)))
            else:
                raise ValueError('unexpected GC support')
    for name,command in commands.items():
        alternate=list(command)
        alternate[alternate.index('--iterations')+1]='17'
        alternate[alternate.index('--seed')+1]='4294967295'
        alternate[alternate.index('--expected')+1]=str(f['alternateExpectedChecksum'])
        report['checks'].append(dict(runtime=name,workload=f['id'],**phase_ci.invoke(alternate,180)))
    case=dict(fixture=f,observations=[],sampleOrders=[])
    report['cases'].append(case)
    for block in range(3):
        rows,order=interleaved.invoke(commands,180,rng)
        case['sampleOrders'].append(order)
        for name,row in rows.items():
            row=dict(row,wasmSha256=f['wasmSha256'])
            phase_ci.validate_observation(row,runtimes[name],f)
            case['observations'].append(dict(row,runtime=name,block=block))
    print('measured',f['id'],flush=True)
    (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
report['status']='complete'
report['hostLoadAfter']=os.getloadavg()
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(survey.summarize(report),indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'report.md').write_text(survey.markdown(report))
print((out/'report.md').read_text())

inlined in both languages; these are source-loop costs, not machine-call latency.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,platform,random,statistics,subprocess,sys
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path[:0]=[str(root/'benchmarks'),str(root/'benchmarks/native'),str(root/'benchmarks/embedded')]
import interleaved,phase_ci,survey
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('embedded_generate',root/'benchmarks/embedded/generate.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
core_oracle=module.checksum
from memory_fixtures import checksum as memory_oracle

build=json.loads((out/'final/build.json').read_text())
runtimes={name:r for name,r in build['runtimes'].items() if not name.startswith('base-')}
source=root.parent/'wasmvm-wt-interpreter-metadata-20261102/benchmarks/native/c/scalar_baseline.c'
native=out/'native-scalar'
sanitized=out/'native-scalar-sanitize'
flags=['-O3','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror']
command=['clang',*flags,'-o',str(native),str(source)]
subprocess.run(command,check=True)
sanitizer_command=['clang','-O1','-g','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-o',str(sanitized),str(source)]
subprocess.run(sanitizer_command,check=True)
report=dict(status='running',acceptance='Descriptive shared-host comparison; controlled acceptance open',sourceRevision=build['head'],
 plan='Six unchanged scalar kernels at 1000000 source iterations; all 4 head Go/LLGo backends and 5 pinned references plus unchecked native C; 3 fresh interleaved process blocks, 2 warmups, 7 warm calls. No setup subtraction. Native C lacks Wasm validation, bounds checks, fuel and cancellation. Volatile indirect kernel entry prevents repeated-call hoisting.',
 runtimes=runtimes,host=dict(platform=platform.platform(),loadBefore=os.getloadavg()),
 nativeCBuild=dict(command=command,sanitizerCommand=sanitizer_command,compiler=subprocess.check_output(['clang','--version'],text=True),
 sourceSha256=survey.digest(source),binarySha256=survey.digest(native)),cases=[],checks=[])
selected={'core/integer-loop','core/function-calls','core/memory-load-store','memory/narrow-unaligned','memory/dependent-address','memory/float64-unaligned'}
rng=random.Random(2026110206)
for original in survey.fixtures(root):
 if original['id'] not in selected:continue
 kind=original['id'].split('/')[1]
 oracle=core_oracle if original['family']=='core' else memory_oracle
 oracle_kind='integer-mix' if kind=='integer-loop' else kind
 count=1000000
 f=dict(original,iterations=count,expectedChecksum=oracle(oracle_kind,original['seed'],count))
 case=dict(fixture=f,observations=[],nativeC=[],sampleOrders=[]);report['cases'].append(case)
 for seed,n in [(305419896,1),(4294967295,17),(305419896,count)]:
  expected=oracle(oracle_kind,seed,n)
  for binary in [native,sanitized]:
   cmd=[str(binary),kind,str(seed),str(n),str(expected)]
   result=subprocess.run(cmd,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
   record=json.loads(result.stdout)
   assert record['checksum']==expected and record['iterations']==n and len(record['warmCallNs'])==7
   report['checks'].append(dict(workload=f['id'],command=cmd,record=record,stderr=result.stderr))
 commands={name:r['command']+['--backend',r['backend'],'--wasm',f['path'],'--iterations',str(count),'--seed',str(f['seed']),'--expected',str(f['expectedChecksum']),'--samples','7','--warmups','2'] for name,r in runtimes.items()}
 commands['native-c']=[str(native),kind,str(f['seed']),str(count),str(f['expectedChecksum'])]
 for block in range(3):
  rows,orders=interleaved.invoke(commands,240,rng)
  case['sampleOrders'].append(orders)
  for name,row in rows.items():
   if name=='native-c':
    assert row['record']['checksum']==f['expectedChecksum'] and row['record']['iterations']==count and len(row['record']['warmCallNs'])==7
    case['nativeC'].append(dict(row,runtime=name,block=block))
   else:
    row=dict(row,wasmSha256=f['wasmSha256']);phase_ci.validate_observation(row,runtimes[name],f)
    case['observations'].append(dict(row,runtime=name,block=block))
  print('measured',f['id'],'block',block+1,flush=True)
  (out/'native-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
report['status']='complete';report['host']['loadAfter']=os.getloadavg()
(out/'native-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
summary=survey.summarize(report)
for case in report['cases']:
 summary.append(dict(workload=case['fixture']['id'],runtime='native-c',warm=statistics.median(statistics.median(r['record']['warmCallNs'])/case['fixture']['iterations'] for r in case['nativeC'])))
(out/'native-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
for row in summary:print(row['workload'],row['runtime'],round(row['warm'],3))
